question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a green present, Bob has a silver present, Claire has a yellow present, Dave has a white present, Eve has a brown present, Fred has a blue present, and Gertrude has a pink present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Gertrude swap their gifts. Finally, Alice and Fred swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Fred has the
Options:
(A) green present
(B) silver present
(C) yellow present
(D) white present
(E) brown present
(F) blue present
(G) pink present
solution:
Each row lists present colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: green, silver, yellow, white, brown, blue, pink
1. Alice and Claire swap: yellow, silver, green, white, brown, blue, pink
2. Eve and Dave swap: yellow, silver, green, brown, white, blue, pink
3. Fred and Alice swap: blue, silver, green, brown, white, yellow, pink
4. Dave and Alice swap: brown, silver, green, blue, white, yellow, pink
5. Eve and Gertrude swap: brown, silver, green, blue, pink, yellow, white
6. Alice and Gertrude swap: white, silver, green, blue, pink, yellow, brown
7. Alice and Fred swap: yellow, silver, green, blue, pink, white, brown
Fred has the white present, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
